_comment: Workbook exercise data-sensor-conditional (docs/workbook/data-sensor-conditional.md): a supply-air sensor reading 3 F high on the synthetic-ahu-sensor-bias units (generated by CAMBER, no real building). The dataset template's three rules and reheat-capacity loads, and report.rcx.references comparing each unit's supply-air sensor with the duct logger in its duct (0.108, #267). The variant data-sensor-conditional--no-reference is the same run without the references: the RCx report before anyone checks the sensors.
